This photograph showcases a minimalist, sunlit living room with a beige color palette. Central to the image is a sleek, beige sofa with a single cushion, positioned against a large, textured wall. A tall, white vase with delicate, dried branches stands to the right. The room features expansive windows allowing natural light to flood in, casting soft shadows. The floor is a smooth, light-colored tile, enhancing the serene, modern aesthetic.

This is a realistic CGI image of a minimalistic, modern living room. A sleek, black and grey front-loading washer and dryer set with a white cloth dryer is on the left, with a white ceramic vase and books atop. A wooden sideboard with a shelf holds more books. A mid-century modern light brown armchair with a beige cushion and a brown throw pillow sits on a round beige rug in front of large windows overlooking a green lawn and trees. The walls and floor are light grey.<|end_of_text|>
一张极简主义的阳光照片捕捉了一个宁静的米色房间，墙壁光滑且有纹理。一个长长的低矮米色沙发靠着墙，上面放着两个靠垫，投下柔和的阴影。一个高大的白色陶瓷花瓶里插着干树枝，站在右侧，靠近大落地窗，让自然光照射进来。这个空间散发着平静和简约的气息，线条简洁，颜色中性。
一间现代简约风格的客厅，采用干净利落的当代设计。核心亮点是配有浅木纹贴面门的流线型内置衣柜。一台黑色前置滚筒洗衣烘干组合机格外醒目。浅棕色扶手椅搭配米色坐垫与木质扶手，摆放在大飘窗旁，让充沛的自然光线洒满房间。椅子下方铺着一块小圆毯。中性色调的搭配强化了空间的通透感。整个设计兼顾功能性与美学格调，完美诠释现代优雅。

A minimalist, sunlit photograph captures a serene, beige-toned room with smooth, textured walls. A long, low-profile beige sofa with two cushions sits against the wall, casting soft shadows. A tall, white ceramic vase with dried twigs stands to the right, near large floor-to-ceiling windows letting in natural light. The space exudes calmness and simplicity, with clean lines and a neutral color palette.

A modern, minimalist living room with a clean, contemporary design. The centerpiece is a sleek, built-in wardrobe with light wood veneer doors. A black front-loading washer and dryer set is prominently featured. The light brown armchair with beige seat cushion and wooden armrests is positioned near a large window, allowing ample natural light to flood the room. A small round rug lies beneath the chair. The neutral tones of the room enhance the airy and open feel. The space is designed for both functionality and aesthetic appeal, embodying modern elegance.<|end_of_text|>
